name: Marketing Prompts
intro: Templates for briefs, content, and campaign planning. Feed them real positioning and real audience data, the output quality tracks the input quality almost linearly.

templates.tip: The banned-words list is where brand voice actually gets enforced, maintain it.
templates.title: Campaign brief to ad variants
templates.models: Any; generate more variants than you need and cut.
templates.prompt: From this campaign brief, produce ad copy. Brief: product {PRODUCT}, audience {AUDIENCE}, key benefit {BENEFIT}, proof point {PROOF}, offer {OFFER}, banned words: {LIST}. Produce: 5 headline options under 40 characters; 3 primary texts under 125 characters; 2 longer variants under 300 characters for LinkedIn. Every variant must contain the benefit or the proof, never both crammed together. Label each with the emotional angle used (fear of loss, aspiration, social proof, curiosity).

templates.tip: Paste the actual top-result headings, do not ask the model what ranks, it does not know.
templates.title: SEO content brief
templates.models: Pair with real SERP research; the model should structure, not invent rankings.
templates.prompt: Build a content brief for the keyword {KEYWORD}. Below are the H2 headings from the current top 5 ranking pages, pasted by me. Produce: 1) search intent in one sentence; 2) a recommended outline (H2/H3) that covers every topic competitors cover plus two gaps they miss; 3) ten related terms to include naturally; 4) a 60-character title and 155-character meta description; 5) three internal-link anchor suggestions for a site about {SITE_TOPIC}. COMPETITOR HEADINGS: {PASTE}

templates.tip: The constraint that every post ties to a pillar prevents the calendar from drifting into filler.
templates.title: Thirty-day social calendar
templates.prompt: Create a 30-day social calendar for {BRAND}, which serves {AUDIENCE}. Content pillars: {PILLAR_1}, {PILLAR_2}, {PILLAR_3}. Mix: 40 percent educational, 30 percent proof (cases, numbers, testimonials), 20 percent product, 10 percent culture. For each day give: pillar, format (text, image, video, poll), a one-line hook, and the call to action. No hashtag stuffing; at most two per post. Output as a table with columns Day, Pillar, Format, Hook, CTA.
